source: User report and supplied screenshots; no gameplay controlled by agent.
report: Hero beard off renders black; Flex beard on renders black. Flex returns to normal with beard off. Hero stays black, including H9.
confirmed_technical_findings: Both original face albedos use streaming VirtualTextures; runtime PNG import creates ordinary Texture2D resources.
The component MID factory can return the already dynamic Hero material, aliasing the saved original.
inference: VT sampling mismatch is the probable black-face cause; exact GPU fallback was not decoded.
follow_up: 0.1.3 separate cooked VT assets and genuinely fresh MID plus copied original overrides; user rendering test pending.
